sections.title: Shakespearean True Crime: Reading Richard III
sections.description: This seminar offers students the opportunity to undertake a semester-long in-depth study of a major literary text from the Medieval and/or Renaissance period with a focus on Difference and Diaspora. Discussions will address emergent research methods, advanced writing and critical thinking issues, and debates surrounding canonization. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of current offerings.
